data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Marwan, which is of Arabic origin and means 'son of Marwan'. Marwan was a prominent Umayyad Caliph who ruled during the early Islamic period. He is known for his military prowess and his contributions to Islamic art and architecture. The name Marwani carries the meaning “From Marwan” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marwani usually hope their child will grow to embody from marwan and live with faith, good character and purpose.
